app_fee.value: Graduate applicants pay a non-refundable $75 application fee.
app_fee.quote: Applicants to our graduate programs pay a non-refundable $75 application fee.

fee_waiver.value: The standard waiver covers Mason faculty and staff and eligible Virginia residents aged 60 or older, so most international applicants pay. A few programs offer their own waivers; see the program records.
fee_waiver.quote: Full-time George Mason faculty or classified staff and eligible Virginia residents, 60 years or older may be eligible for an application fee waiver

gre_general.value: Mason sets no university-wide GRE rule; each program states its own in its record.

toefl_min.value: Graduate applicants need an overall 5.0 with 4.5 in each section for tests taken from January 21, 2026; older tests need 88 with 20 in each section.
toefl_min.quote: Tests taken January 21, 2026 or later: 5.0 and 4.5 each subsection

also.quote: Tests taken before January 21, 2026: 88 and 20 each subsection

ielts_min.value: Graduate applicants need an IELTS Academic overall band of 7.0 with at least 6.5 in each section; College of Engineering and Computing programs accept 6.5.

english_waiver.value: India is not on Mason's list of waiver-eligible countries, so an Indian degree does not waive the English test and a score is needed.
english_waiver.quote: Graduate or Undergraduate applicants who have completed a bachelor's degree or higher degree from a George Mason-recognized institution in the United States or a waiver-eligible country below

also.quote: Ghana Gibraltar Grenada Guam Guyana Ireland Jamaica

notes: Set from gmu.edu and graduate.gmu.edu pages. The College of Engineering and Computing (CEC) uses lower English scores; its programs carry overrides. Mason's GRE policy is set program by program.
